request.reason: The customer has had three broadband faults in seven weeks, on 8 September, 5 October and 22 October 2026, and was without service on parts of ten calendar days. Automatic compensation covered only the one day by which Kestrel missed a repair target.

evidence_available.summary: The first fault was reported on 8 September 2026 and repaired on 11 September 2026, one day after the repair target. The line test placed the fault between the street cabinet and the property.
evidence_available.establishes: The dates and length of the first fault, and that it was on the Kestrel network.

evidence_available.summary: Automatic compensation of £8.00 was applied on 15 September 2026 for one day after the repair target.
evidence_available.establishes: The automatic compensation already paid for the first fault.

evidence_available.summary: The second fault was reported on 5 October 2026 and repaired on 7 October 2026, within the repair target. A fibre joint in the street was remade.
evidence_available.establishes: The dates and length of the second fault, and that it was on the Kestrel network.

evidence_available.summary: The third fault was reported on 22 October 2026. The line test failed outside the property, and service was restored on 24 October 2026, within the repair target.
evidence_available.establishes: The dates and length of the third fault, and that no automatic compensation is due for it.

evidence_available.summary: On 26 October 2026 the customer complained about three faults in seven weeks and asked for compensation.
evidence_available.establishes: The customer's complaint. It is the customer's description and is not evidence of cause.

evidence_missing.description: The engineer's report for the visit on 24 October 2026, which records the cause of the third fault.
evidence_missing.why_needed: The goodwill credit policy requires evidence that the failure was Kestrel's responsibility. The case says only that the fault was outside the property.

evidence_missing.description: A billing record of the credits applied to the account in the last 12 months.
evidence_missing.why_needed: The goodwill credit policy allows no more than one goodwill credit for the same fault, and the approver must see the compensation already paid.

supplementary_evidence.summary: The engineer's report says that water had damaged a fibre joint in the street duct outside the property. The duct is part of the Kestrel network, and the same duct section was involved in the faults of 8 September and 5 October 2026.
In the last 12 months the account received automatic compensation of £8.00 on 15 September 2026 and no goodwill credits.

decision_states.meaning: The approval request has been received and is waiting for a supervisor.
A supervisor is checking the request against the goodwill credit policy and the evidence.
The supervisor has named the evidence that is missing. The request returns to review when the evidence arrives, and is rejected if it has not arrived within 10 working days.
The supervisor has approved the amount. Billing applies the credit to the next bill within 5 working days.
The request is refused, and the reason is recorded in the case history.
Billing has applied the credit to the customer's account.
